lines.text: These tears are diamonds, falling from my eyes
Every drop a memory of all our goodbyes
I thought forever meant we’d never have to choose
But sometimes love leaves scars we never lose
Still I wouldn’t trade a single night we shared
Even when it hurts, I know you cared
Diamond tears, shining through the pain
Turning every heartbreak into something beautiful again
I’ll wear them proudly, let them light my way
Diamond tears, reminding me I’m okay
The nights feel longer when your side is cold
But I’m learning how to stand on my own
Every lesson written in these crystal lines
Helps me see the beauty in what’s left behind
Still I wouldn’t trade a single night we shared
Even when it hurts, I know you cared
Diamond tears, shining through the pain
Turning every heartbreak into something beautiful again
I’ll wear them proudly, let them light my way
Diamond tears, reminding me I’m okay
These tears don’t break me, they remake me whole
Diamond tears, shining through the pain
Turning every heartbreak into something beautiful again
I’ll wear them proudly, let them light my way
Diamond tears, reminding me I’m okay
